The '''port master's walking stick''' was a staff owned by [[Port Administrator]] [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was fashioned from an exotic alloy.<ref name="Visual dictionary" /> When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived on Utapau in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the stick reminded him of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Gimer stick/Legends|gimer stick]].<ref name="ROTS">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>
